name: Train For Brainrots
desc:
Welcome to Train for Brainrots!

💥 Lift weights and carry brainrots from each area!
💰 Bring them back to your base to earn money!
💪 Gain more strength to destroy more walls!
⬆️ Upgrade your base for even more brainrots!

Don't forget to like & favorite the game for more updates! 👍
